record_body:
Account summary
- Existing Private/VPC customer (regulated workload). Primary region: us-east (Helios VPC), exploring secondary DR in us-west.
- Workload: clinician note summarization + internal knowledge assistant. Sensitive text; strict access controls.
- Current posture: production traffic (limited set of internal users) + expansion request contingent on SSO + audit-log evidence.

Key requirements (Security/Compliance)
- SSO: SAML 2.0 required (Okta). Needs documented process for IdP metadata rotation + cert expiry playbook.
- RBAC: role-based access in Redwood Console; “least privilege” and separate admin roles (Helios wants break-glass procedure documented).
- Audit logging: required for auth events + model invocation events (at minimum: user/service principal, timestamp, action, project, request_id correlation). Needs export to SIEM (Splunk) and retention controls.
- KMS: customer-managed key (AWS KMS) for secrets/at-rest encryption in VPC deployment.
- Data residency: US-only; no cross-region failover without explicit approval.

Recent support escalation (SSO)
- 2026-02-07: Helios reported SSO/SAML login failures after IdP change ("we updated Okta app + cert and now admins can’t login").
- Jira: SUP-4923 (Private) — required escalation to Security + Private Deployments.
- Observed symptoms (from Helios + Support): SAML response rejected intermittently; spike in auth failures after metadata update; admin sessions expiring.
- Mitigation/workaround applied: temporarily rolled back IdP cert/metadata on Helios side + Redwood support provided updated ACS/EntityID validation checklist; access restored.
- Follow-up ask from Helios Security: written guidance for future IdP changes + what logs we provide during auth incidents (audit log fields, timestamps, correlation IDs).

Security review status
- Status: In progress (Helios Security GRC reviewing).
- Open items requested by Helios:
  - Evidence of audit-log availability + sample export (redacted) showing auth events and admin changes.
  - Confirmation of audit-log retention controls for Private deployments (who controls retention + where stored).
  - Clarify after-hours escalation expectations for Private incidents (they referenced need for “24/7 escalation path for auth outages”).
- Internal owners looped: Marcus Lin (Security escalation), Vivek Kulkarni (Private deployments), Dev Patel (Support program lead).

Activity timeline (recent)
- 2026-01-28: QBR-style check-in (Rachel Kim + Liam O’Rourke). Helios flagged audit logging + SSO as gate for expansion.
- 2026-02-07: Support escalation opened (SUP-4923). Security/Private engaged.
- 2026-02-10: Internal review thread on escalation playbook + comms alignment (see Gmail: thread_20260210_escalation_playbook_reviews).
- 2026-02-12: CS leadership aligning enterprise SLA language (Gmail: thread_20260212_enterprise_sla_alignment). Helios mentioned as example of “SSO outage = Sev0”.
- 2026-02-18: Working session referenced Fireflies (ff_9f3c1a2b_escalation_policy_sync) — aligned on severity + escalation triggers for auth/SSO failures in Private.
- 2026-02-20: Helios requested “safe-to-share” runbook snippet for SAML changes + audit-log field list; asked for sample comms cadence for auth outage.

Notes / call snippets
- Helios Security: “If SSO breaks, it’s effectively a complete outage for our users. We need an escalation path that doesn’t bounce between teams.”
- Helios Platform Eng: wants request_id correlation to tie app logs -> Redwood -> audit logs; asked if request IDs persist across retries.
- They are sensitive to any suggestion of cross-region failover; prefer in-VPC mitigations first.

Next steps (internal)
- Provide Helios a vetted SAML metadata rotation checklist + recommended change window steps (pre-validate, rollback plan, who-to-page).
- Share sample audit-log export (redacted) and confirm event schema + retention knobs for Private.
- Confirm SLA/escalation language applicable to Private auth incidents; ensure Support uses new required fields + escalation template for any future SSO issues.

Next steps (customer-facing)
- Schedule 45-min session with Helios IdP owner to walk through SAML config + test plan (pre-prod if possible).
- Confirm SIEM integration approach for audit logs (format + delivery) and document as part of security sign-off.
